author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Patient lying face down along the bottom (straight body, head at the right) with the therapist above as a user-style bust whose arm reaches down to press on the patient's back, following the reference's therapist-over-patient layout. The current drawing had a kneeling stick figure with a zigzag body beside a detached ring and a slanted bar, so it did not read as one person treating another.
omissions: The patient is a single stroke instead of the reference's outlined bent-leg body, and the floor line is left out (no room for 8 spacing under the patient's head).
